reviewer: Codex AI-assisted semantic review; no independent human signoff
method: Same frozen 16 questions, 32 gold facts and rubric. 1=correct, 0.5=partial, 0=absent/wrong. Supporting labels identify supplied and actually cited records supporting each credited fact, not exhaustive precision of every sentence. Wiki-only explanations cannot establish canonical confirmation. Diagnostics are excluded from the positive denominator. All 32 final raw responses were read. The earlier candidate is preserved separately and none of its answers is substituted into the final run.
